description: You are moderating the 'AnnualTownHall' meeting. The 'Keynote Speaker' (a guest participant) is about to begin their address. Your task is to PIN the 'Keynote Speaker' to your screen so they remain the main focus in Stage View (large central video), regardless of who is speaking. Locate the participant named 'Keynote Speaker', pin their video tile, and ensure they are the dominant video in your view.
